SRC-133:R0001.text: EXEC-RESPONSE-01 is enforced by active runtime/bootstrap architecture, not only prose documentation.

SRC-133:R0002.text: Every operational boundary exposes the mandatory fields in canonical order.

SRC-133:R0003.text: No free prose appears before the control surface.

SRC-133:R0006.text: NEXT EXACT ACTION is always exact.

SRC-133:R0008.text: DETAILS is optional and always last.

SRC-133:R0010.text: Future sessions automatically inherit the contract.

SRC-133:R0011.text: Cold recovery automatically inherits the contract.

SRC-133:R0012.text: Executor/model replacement does not remove the contract.

SRC-133:R0013.text: An agent cannot return to the operator merely because a phase ended when eligible autonomous work remains.

SRC-133:R0014.text: OPERATOR ACTION = NONE plus eligible work causes autonomous continuation.

SRC-133:R0015.text: Genuine operator-only boundaries return the canonical response instead of prose.

SRC-133:R0016.text: The observed CLEAN/conformance failure class has deterministic regression coverage.

SRC-133:R0017.text: Protocol conformance can detect stale or missing response-contract binding where technically possible.

SRC-133:R0018.text: Full validation is green with new_red=0.

SRC-133:R0019.text: STATE, BOARD, LOG, and recovery evidence are reconciled.

SRC-133:R0020.text: Another executor can cold-start from repository state and follow the response contract without access to this conversation.
